source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical patch removes preference-sized folder header chunks and its timing-sensitive chunk test. In accepted source GetMsgHdrsToDownload moves all queued UIDs and resets the queue. The protocol uses the returned list length for progress, clears the more-header flag, fetches that list and completes the header stage. This says nothing about other protocol limits or an ideal cross-folder scheduling policy. Static source only; no timing or server experiment.
title: IMAP header download hands the whole queued UID list to the protocol
